@graph.name: 4 Day Ijen, Papuma Beach, Tumpak Sewu & Bromo Journey from Surabaya

review.reviewBody: Overall, a great experience! We booked the 4D3N Ijen, Papuma, Tumpak Sewu & Bromo tour (with the Madakaripura Waterfall add-on). Our guide, Gufron, was fun, communicative, and always willing to share interesting facts—plus, we bonded over our shared taste in music, which made the trip even more memorable. The driver was also great and drove very steadily, so we always felt safe.\n\nThe itinerary is quite packed and can be tiring, but every attraction is absolutely worth it. Just a small tip: make sure to bring a good pair of hiking shoes for Ijen! Highly recommended!
